m: अध्रि mfn. (√ धृ), unrestrained, irresistible, (अद्रि with the MSS.; ग्रावा अद्रिः = ‘press-stone’) AV. v, 20, 10.
a: अध्रि — a. [न-धृ-कि] Not restrained, irresistible. --Comp. --गु-गू a. [अध्रि-गम्-कू-डिच् ऊङादेशोवा] of irresistible motion or course (अधृतगमन), impetuous; यदध्रिगावो अग्निगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना Rv. 8. 22. 11 --(गुः) N. of a heavenly killer of sacrificial victims, or the name of the formula itself ending with an invocation of Agni. --ज a. [अध्रिं जनयति, जन्-ड] making irresistible. --पुष्पलिका the betelnut plant.

a: अध्रियमाण — a. 1 Not held, not to be got hold of; not forthcoming. --2 Not surviving, dead.

m: अ-ध्रुव mf(आ)n. not fixed, not permanent
a: अध्रुव — a. 1 Uncertain, doubtful. --2 Unsteady, moving, not fixed or permanent; स्वांगेऽध्रुवे P. III. 4. 54; separable (which can be severed or detached without fatal or disastrous effects) (येन विना न जीवनं सो ऽध्रुवः Sk.) --वं An uncertainty; यो ध्रुवाणि परित्यज्य अध्रुवाणि निषेवते . ध्रुवाणि तस्य नश्यंति अध्रुवं नष्टमेव च; cf. the English phrase ‘A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.’
